text: A psalm of David.The Lord says to my lord: [1]"Sit at my right hand,while I make your enemies your footstool." [2] [AA]
The scepter of your might:the Lord extends your strong scepter from Zion.Have dominion over your enemies!
Yours is princely power from the day of your birth.In holy splendor before the daystar,like dew I begot you. [AB]
The Lord has sworn and will not waver:"You are a priest forever in the manner of Melchizedek." [3] [AC]
At your right hand is the Lord,who crushes kings on the day of his wrath, [AD]
Who judges nations, heaps up corpses,crushes heads across the wide earth,
t[4]Who drinks from the brook by the waysideand thus holds high his head. [AE]
